title: Fuel Charging and Controls — 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
I approach fuel charging with two questions: how does the system do its job, and what does each component contribute? Think of fuel metering as portion control—the useful explanation needs both the overall process and the parts responsible for it.

This entry directs you to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual for those explanations for this engine. It is a reference signpost, with no component inventory, test sequence or repair instructions.

edits.text: For an explanation of fuel-charging and controls system operation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: The operating explanation provides the system-wide context needed to understand the components’ individual jobs.

edits.text: For descriptions of the fuel-charging and controls components, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
